title: DefiNFT
tagline: Decentralized NFT collateralization platform with a vested escrow component that allows liquidity providers to earn rewards
description: This project combines defi and NFTs to provide a platform for people to loan and/or borrow tokens. If a person would like provide some capital for a loan, they are able to do so and provide the terms of the loan. A person looking to collateralize their NFT can browse the loans, select one that fits their needs, and exchange their NFT for the desired amount of capital. If the loan is not repaid with the specified time period, the lender gets to claim the NFT. The lender will get benefits like interest repaid and rewards in the form of an ERC20 token.
